statements.t: The Company expects to resubmit the new drug application (NDA) for CTx-1301 between December 2026 and January 2027.

“With the manufacturing work substantially complete, we are now finalizing the data and documentation needed to resubmit the NDA for CTx-1301, and we expect to do so by January 2027, potentially sooner,” stated Cingulate Chairman and CEO Shane J.
As announced on November 9, 2026, the Company expects to resubmit the NDA between December 2026 and January 2027.

On June 1, 2026, the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the CTx-1301 NDA; the Company and its CDMO have since substantially completed the manufacturing work required to address the CMC requests, and the Company expects to resubmit the NDA between December 2026 and January 2026.
